# ACP Democracy — AI Crawler Guidance

ACP Democracy is the Anti-Corruption Party's open social-democracy platform. It provides tools for civic participation, candidate research, and transparent political engagement.

## Public Sections

- / — Home feed: community posts, announcements, and polls
- /news — Latest political news and articles
- /elections — Election information, race listings, and candidate comparisons
- /lobbies — Special-interest group (SIG/lobby) directory and sponsorship data
- /parties — Political party profiles with transparency ratings and policy positions
- /politicians/:id — Individual politician profiles with corruption-grade scores, FEC data, and SIG sponsorships
- /read/:id — Long-form articles and in-depth policy explainers
- /posts/:id — Community posts and discussions
- /signals/:id — Short civic-engagement videos (Signals)
- /political-compass — 20-question political compass quiz (public, no login required)
- /budget-simulator — Interactive federal budget simulator using CBO baseline data

## Purpose

This platform aims to increase political accountability by surfacing campaign-finance data, SIG sponsorships, and community-driven corruption grades for elected officials and candidates. All politician and election data is presented neutrally and is sourced from FEC public records.

## Authentication

Most content is publicly readable. Voting, posting, and saving quiz results require an account.
